question: Can the potential 28-fascicle Tianjin Xing Yunlu 古今律曆考 digital listing be pursued via an expressly public, login-free first-party library reader rather than treating Commons file-list entries as acquired PDFs?

firstparty_publication_evidence.observed: Announces revised 天津图书馆历史文献数字资源库 beta, official entry http://lswx.tjl.tj.cn:8001, public beta 2026-01-05 through 2026-02-04, and 免登录直接使用. This proves an institutional route and its publication claims, not a present source-item browse result.

firstparty_publication_evidence.publisher: 国家图书馆/国家古籍保护中心
firstparty_publication_evidence.observed: 11th digital-ancient-books joint-release page links Tianjin's history database at the identical :8001 URL; its highlighted newly released Tianjin material is 潮州歌册, not an inventory claim for this Xing source.
First-party report describes HTML5 upgraded site with no account required; is a service-capability report, not an item/page access proof.

access_probe.web_tool: Direct HTTP/HTTPS nonstandard-port opening did not yield a valid source reference; no provider-side HTTP response code or content was obtained.
access_probe.commons_specific_pdf: Attempt to open the named volume18 Commons file page was unsuccessful in the search/browser environment; a file-list title is not a verified uploaded PDF object.

provenance_scope: An official public reading platform does not prove the catalog item is present in the same edition or available today.
The new web reader and Commons NLC892-GBZX0301013346 file-list may describe the same institutional collection; these are access paths, not independently voting physical copies.
Publication of a current digital platform cannot adjudicate the original 1607 secondary print attribution, original woodblocks or Xu-An/NCL copy relation.
Tool inability to open port 8001 is not evidence of provider downtime, holdings absence or paywall.
The item-specific PDF/folio must be positively opened and bound by provider/item/volume/page/image SHA before any numeral or historical method is awarded.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Official reader link and Commons catalog listing are not separate source-original witnesses, nor a proved edition/impression lineage.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Can the publicly announced Tianjin reader yield a search result for the exact GBZX0301013346 source and printed juan45 target image?
Does any authenticated Tianjin original leaf directly settle Xu-An j45 table B L132 二/三 or 疾捷法/少微 without conflating print date and digital object?

next_action: Attempt lawful anonymous direct item-level search in the first-party Tianjin http://lswx.tjl.tj.cn:8001 reader if a capable HTTP/browser interface is available; then bind a positive book item, original fascicle/juan45 boundaries, folio SHA and native glyphs. Otherwise return to already authenticated early Xu-An/CBM and other independent original access routes; no user login, fee, inferred negative proof or numeric guess.
